# UAR architecture-history review

Source under review: `88ae2a1f`

| Constraint | Observed result | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| ADR denominator | Pass: 18 unique retained ADRs exist, and the superseded ADR-0002 points to ADR-0017. | Acceptance is decision status, not delivery evidence. |
| Correction completeness | Pass: seven selected corrections cover license, frontend, visual authority, Pages artifacts, JWT crypto, verification location, and inference evidence. | The selection is intentionally not a complete transcript. |
| Private-source boundary | Pass: direct wiki authority and an exact private-history copy failed closed; composed publication controls also reject machine paths, credentials, private keys, and raw payloads. | Reviewed synthesis may cite classified private records without publishing their bodies. |
| Current authority | Pass: every selected decision has an existing present authority, and public guides state that current source/specification outranks history. | Source-path existence cannot prove semantic freshness by itself. |
| Site source integrity | Pass: five history guides, TypeScript, truth, architecture, README, publication, Actions policy, and strict OpenSpec validation passed. | No production build, browser, accessibility, deployment, or runtime behavior was exercised. |

## Uncomfortable finding

The retained project story is not linear. The runtime license, primary frontend,
visual authority, JWT provider, Pages artifact policy, test location, and
inference evidence boundary all changed after earlier positions were documented.
Hiding those reversals would make current safeguards look arbitrary and would
allow superseded guidance to regain authority by accident.

## Deferred evidence

Rendered navigation, visual quality, keyboard behavior, accessibility, search,
production output, GitHub Pages deployment, live routes, and runtime/profile
behavior remain outside this content review.
